the same bushel yields only enough re\u0026#xfb01;ned \u0026#xfb02;our to make about 42 loaves.\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022field field-name-quote-read-more-link\u0022\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/blog\/2015\/07\/drought-friendly-diet-starts-whole-grains\u0022 class=\u0022arrow-link\u0022\u003EHow whole grains help save the planet\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\n","\u003Cdiv  class=\u0022ds-1col node node-quote view-mode-full clearfix\u0022\u003E\n\n  \n  \u003Cdiv class=\u0022field field-name-body\u0022\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhole white wheat \u0026#xfb02;our is made from an albino strain of wheat, and has all the nutrition of traditional whole wheat \u0026#xfb02;our \u2013 but with a lighter color and milder \u0026#xfb02;avor.\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022field field-name-quote-read-more-link\u0022\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/whole-grains-101\/whats-whole-grain-refined-grain\/whole-white-wheat-faq\u0022 class=\u0022arrow-link\u0022\u003EMore about white wheat\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\n"]},"eu_cookie_compliance":{"popup_enabled":1,"popup_agreed_enabled":0,"popup_hide_agreed":0,"popup_clicking_confirmation":false,"popup_scrolling_confirmation":false,"popup_html_info":"\u003Cdiv\u003E\n  \u003Cdiv class=\u0022popup-content info\u0022\u003E\n    \u003Cdiv id=\u0022popup-text\u0022\u003E\n      \u003Cp\u003EThis website\u00a0uses cookies to make your website experience better. The message: every whole grain in your diet helps!</div><div class="field field-name-node-link"><a class="arrow-link" href="/whole-grains-101/health-studies-health-benefits/what-are-health-benefits">Learn more</a></div> </div>
</div>
</div></div></div> </div>
</div>
</div><!-- /.block -->
<div class="block block-lunchbox odd" id="block-lunchbox-combo-quote-mission">
<div class="block-inner">
<div class="content">
<div class="block block-block first odd" id="block-block-11" style="height: 507px;">
<div class="block-inner">
<h2 class="block__title block-title">Our mission</h2>
<div class="content">
<p>The Whole Grains Council helps consumers ﬁnd whole grain foods and understand their health beneﬁts; helps manufacturers and restaurants create delicious whole grain foods; and helps the media write accurate, compelling stories about whole grains.</p>
<p><a class="arrow-link" href="/about-us">Learn more about us</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div><!-- /.block -->
<div class="block block-views even" id="block-views-quote-block-1" style="height: 507px;">
<div class="block-inner">
<h2 class="block__title block-title">Did you know?</h2>
<div class="content">
<div class="view view-quote view-id-quote view-display-id-block_1 view-dom-id-d95b8aefe477f33b5a7977de51f65f40">
<div class="view-content"><div class="ds-1col node node-quote view-mode-full clearfix">
<div class="field field-name-body"><p>Eating an average of 2.5 servings of whole grain foods each day can lower your risk of cardiovascular disease by almost one-quarter</p>
</div><div class="field field-name-quote-read-more-link"><a class="arrow-link" href="/whole-grains-101/health-studies/search%3Fkeys%3D%26disease%255B%255D%3Dheart%26items_per_page%3D12">More on heart health and whole grains</a></div></div>
</div>
</div> </div>
</div>
</div><!-- /.block -->
</div>
</div>
</div><!-- /.block -->
<div class="block block-views plain last even" id="block-views-blog-block">
<div class="block-inner">
<h2 class="block__title block-title">What's new in Whole Grains</h2>
<div class="content">
<div class="view view-blog view-id-blog view-display-id-block blog-thumbnails-home view-dom-id-78660a78edc7b26ba7404d3ae1fcaf18">
<div class="view-content">
<div class="views-row views-row-1 views-row-odd views-row-first">
<div class="ds-1col node node-blog-article node-promoted view-mode-long_teaser clearfix">
<div class="field field-name-post-date">October 16, 2019</div><div class="field field-name-field-teaser-image" style="background-image: none;"><!-- scald=7006:teaser {"link":"node\/46891"} --><div class="ds-1col scald-atom view-mode-teaser clearfix">
<a class="ilink" href="/blog/2019/10/baking-intact-grains"><img alt="KellyToups_WholeGrainBread_IggysBakery.jpg" height="300" src="https://wholegrainscouncil.org/sites/default/files/styles/teaser/public/thumbnails/image/KellyToups_WholeGrainBread_IggysBakery.jpg?itok=LnaRoMGQ" title="KellyToups_WholeGrainBread_IggysBakery.jpg" width="400"/></a></div>
<!-- END scald=7006 --></div><div class="field field-name-title"><h2><a href="/blog/2019/10/baking-intact-grains">Baking with Intact Grains</a></h2></div><div class="field field-name-field-intro">Most whole grain breads are made with whole grains that have been milled into fine particles to form a whole grain flour, in a mixture that contains all of the grain kernel’s original bran, germ, and endosperm. But if ground whole grains are great, might intact whole grains be better?</div><div class="field field-name-node-link"><a class="" href="/blog/2019/10/baking-intact-grains">Read more</a></div></div>
</div>
<div class="views-row views-row-2 views-row-even">
<div class="ds-1col node node-blog-article view-mode-long_teaser clearfix">
<div class="field field-name-post-date">October 2, 2019</div><div class="field field-name-field-teaser-image" style="background-image: none;"><!-- scald=7808:teaser {"link":"node\/46829"} --><div class="ds-1col scald-atom view-mode-teaser clearfix">
<a class="ilink" href="/blog/2019/10/climate-resiliency-through-biodiversity-and-local-grain-economies"><img alt="Grain By Grain book cover" height="300" src="https://wholegrainscouncil.org/sites/default/files/styles/teaser/public/thumbnails/image/51iyczKTveL.jpg?itok=lYbgSG7i" title="GrainbyGrain.jpg" width="400"/></a></div>
<!-- END scald=7808 --></div><div class="field field-name-title"><h2><a href="/blog/2019/10/climate-resiliency-through-biodiversity-and-local-grain-economies">Climate Resiliency through Biodiversity and Local Grain Economies</a></h2></div><div class="field field-name-field-intro">At a time when increasingly urgent headlines about climate change are commonplace, and many farmers are facing tough economic situations, this story about the importance of biodiversity, economic resiliency, rural communities, and the value of ecological health seems particularly poignant.</div><div class="field field-name-node-link"><a class="" href="/blog/2019/10/climate-resiliency-through-biodiversity-and-local-grain-economies">Read more</a></div></div>
</div>
<div class="views-row views-row-3 views-row-odd views-row-last">
<div class="ds-1col node node-blog-article node-promoted view-mode-long_teaser clearfix">
<div class="field field-name-post-date">September 18, 2019</div><div class="field field-name-field-teaser-image" style="background-image: none;"><!-- scald=7921:teaser {"link":"node\/46760"} --><div class="ds-1col scald-atom view-mode-teaser clearfix">
<a class="ilink" href="/blog/2019/09/trust-your-gut"><img alt="Loaves of bread" height="300" src="https://wholegrainscouncil.org/sites/default/files/styles/teaser/public/thumbnails/image/Photo%20by%20Liene%20Geidane%20on%20Unsplash.jpg?itok=X6aGVJe_" title="Photo by Liene Geidane on Unsplash.jpg" width="400"/></a></div>
<!-- END scald=7921 --></div><div class="field field-name-title"><h2><a href="/blog/2019/09/trust-your-gut">Trust your Gut</a></h2></div><div class="field field-name-field-intro">Supporting our microbiota with a balanced, plant-based diet full of naturally fiber-rich foods is the best path to a healthy gut.</div><div class="field field-name-node-link"><a class="" href="/blog/2019/09/trust-your-gut">Read more</a></div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="more-link">
<a href="/blog">
    See more posts  </a>
</div>
</div> </div>
</div>
